falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 3.5% above its verdict-day close within 14 calendar days and finishes that window at a 20-day closing high, while similarity to mini_top_2019_jun prints below 45%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini-top analog was a false positive and the phase resolved to upside continuation, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was the wrong call.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5% below the highest close of the 10 sessions before the verdict within 14 calendar days, and VIX closes above 24 on that same session.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 74% mini_top_2019_jun match resolved into a confirmed risk-off break, so HOLD was wrong and UNKNOWN was no longer defensible.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score reaches 80 or higher and, inside the same 14-day window, the S&P 500 closes at least 4% below the intraday high of the session on which the score first printed 80.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 56 was mis-specified; a completed blowoff top occurred, invalidating both the UNKNOWN phase label and the HOLD signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
